meta.title: Variation Converter for WooCommerce demo
meta.description: WooCommerce with 32 simple products that are really a few products in several variants, including tees in color and size and coffee in grind and weight. Search or scan, then combine them into variable products.
meta.author: craigpestell

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
foreach ( array(
	'woocommerce_currency' => 'USD', 'woocommerce_default_country' => 'US:OR', 'woocommerce_coming_soon' => 'no',
	'woocommerce_store_pages_only' => 'no', 'woocommerce_allow_tracking' => 'no', 'woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions' => 'no',
	'woocommerce_task_list_hidden' => 'yes', 'woocommerce_extended_task_list_hidden' => 'yes',
	'woocommerce_onboarding_profile' => array( 'skipped' => true ), 'blogname' => 'Demo Store',
) as $name => $value ) {
	update_option( $name, $value );
}
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
function demo_cat( $name ) {
	$term = term_exists( $name, 'product_cat' ) ?: wp_insert_term( $name, 'product_cat' );
	return (int) $term['term_id'];
}
$apparel = demo_cat( 'Apparel' );
$drink   = demo_cat( 'Drinkware' );
$coffee  = demo_cat( 'Coffee' );
$rows = array(
	array( 'Classic Tee Black', 'TEE100-BLK', 24, $apparel, 18 ),
	array( 'Classic Tee Blue', 'TEE100-BLU', 24, $apparel, 7 ),
	array( 'Classic Tee Red', 'TEE100-RED', 24, $apparel, 0 ),
	array( 'Classic Tee White', 'TEE100-WHT', 24, $apparel, 25 ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Black Small', 'ET-BLK-S', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Black Medium', 'ET-BLK-M', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Black Large', 'ET-BLK-L', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee White Small', 'ET-WHT-S', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee White Medium', 'ET-WHT-M', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee White Large', 'ET-WHT-L', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Navy Small', 'ET-NVY-S', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Navy Medium', 'ET-NVY-M', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Everyday Tee Navy Large', 'ET-NVY-L', 22, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Organic V-Neck Tee (Small)', 'VN220-S', 28, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Organic V-Neck Tee (Medium)', 'VN220-M', 28, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Organic V-Neck Tee (Large)', 'VN220-L', 28, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Organic V-Neck Tee (XL)', 'VN220-XL', 30, $apparel, null ),
	array( 'Enamel Camp Mug 12oz Navy', 'MUG12-NV', 16, $drink, null ),
	array( 'Enamel Camp Mug 12oz Red', 'MUG12-RD', 16, $drink, null ),
	array( 'Enamel Camp Mug 12oz Forest Green', 'MUG12-FG', 16, $drink, null ),
	array( 'Speckled Stoneware Mug', 'MUG-SPK', 22, $drink, null ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Whole Bean 340g', 'CF340-WB', 15, $coffee, 40 ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Ground 340g', 'CF340-GR', 15, $coffee, 12 ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Espresso Grind 340g', 'CF340-ES', 15, $coffee, 3 ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Whole Bean 1kg', 'CF1000-WB', 38, $coffee, 20 ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Ground 1kg', 'CF1000-GR', 38, $coffee, 8 ),
	array( 'House Blend Coffee Espresso Grind 1kg', 'CF1000-ES', 38, $coffee, 5 ),
	array( 'Barista Syrup Vanilla 250ml', 'SYR-VA-02', 9, $coffee, null ),
	array( 'Barista Syrup Vanilla 750ml', 'SYR-VA-07', 19, $coffee, null ),
	array( 'Barista Syrup Caramel 250ml', 'SYR-CA-02', 9, $coffee, null ),
	array( 'Barista Syrup Caramel 750ml', 'SYR-CA-07', 19, $coffee, null ),
	array( 'Barista Syrup Caramel 1L', 'SYR-CA-10', 24, $coffee, null ),
);
foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
	if ( wc_get_product_id_by_sku( $row[1] ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	$p = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$p->set_name( $row[0] );
	$p->set_sku( $row[1] );
	$p->set_regular_price( (string) $row[2] );
	$p->set_category_ids( array( $row[3] ) );
	if ( null !== $row[4] ) {
		$p->set_manage_stock( true );
		$p->set_stock_quantity( $row[4] );
	}
	$p->set_status( 'publish' );
	$p->save();
}
